_comment: Spirits (2026-11-13, integrator C1), Millicent's AFFINITY FOR SPIRITS fed IN THE SAME MAIN by Lingering Souls: five lands, three Spirits out (Phantom, Wanderer, Shacklegeist). Souls {2}{W} makes two Spirit tokens, then Millicent costs {W}{U} (7 - 5): 3 + 2 = 5. Priced at the plan's start she is {2}{W}{U}, so 3 + 4 = 7 > 5: the line needs (a) the generic AFFINITY cast-order tier (25), which casts her after Souls (20) -- as a tier-10 creature she was cast BEFORE it -- and (b) the token credit in SameTurnAffinityDiscountFor (AffinityFeedCount). Opponent 28: only Souls + Millicent on T5 (Wanderer pumped by three entering Spirits, Millicent's combat tokens off the three connecting Spirits) kills T6. With MTG_NO_COST_TRICKS=1 (credit off: the pre-fix enumeration) this fixture reads win T7.
